name: flextext-desktop
description: Desktop shell for the Flextext editor — exists solely for archive-quality audio capture.

//: ffmpeg.exe ships in resources/ because audio.js looks at process.resourcesPath FIRST. It is
invoked as a separate process and never linked, so its GPL terms do not reach this app's own
code. Without it the shell still opens, but reports ffmpeg_not_found and the engine falls back
to browser capture - which defeats the only reason this shell exists.
PORTABLE, not an installer: no admin rights, nothing in Program Files or the registry, and it
uninstalls by deleting the file. That matters on a machine that is not ours.
